# Boords

> > Boords is a collaborative storyboarding and video script editing platform with AI-powered tools for filmmakers, animators, and video creators.

The platform offers end-to-end pre-production workflow tools including AI script generation, online drawing tools, animatics creation, and team collaboration features. Boords serves video professionals across film, YouTube, TikTok, and commercial production with export options for client-ready deliverables.

## Key Topics

- Storyboarding
- Video production workflow
- AI script generation
- Animatics
- Pre-production planning
- Visual storytelling
- Team collaboration
- Two-column AV format
- Camera moves
- Film editing
- YouTube and TikTok content
- Client sharing and exports
- Filmmaking tools
- Script editing
- Drawing and image generation

## Core Features & Tools

- [Create | Boords](https://boords.com/create): Storyboard creation with AI tools and client-ready output
- [AI Script Generator: Free Video Scripts, No Signup | Boords](https://boords.com/ai-script-generator): Free AI tool generating video scripts for YouTube, TikTok, commercials
- [Video Script Editing Software | Boords](https://boords.com/script-editing-software): Video script editing and collaboration tool with storyboarding
- [Online Storyboard Drawing Tool | Boords](https://boords.com/drawing-tool): Online drawing tool with AI image generation and camera moves
